Home / Family stays

Family stays
at the estate.

Children of all ages are welcome at the estate.

Children of all ages are welcome at the Domaine !

Everything has been thought of with their safety and enjoyment in mind.

The Domaine is a quiet place, children can play safely as we are situated at the end of the road, no passing traffic anywhere near.

For the little ones:

Baby cots on demand, 2 comfortable high chairs, 2 bouncy chairs, a changing table, baby bath tub, kids cutlery.

A chest full of toys and books, floats and a baby swimming aid for the pool (from 6 months and under adult supervision).

For bigger kids:

Outside:

  • Swimming pool with toys and floats
  • Tennis court with rackets and balls
  • Ping pong table with bats and balls
  • Petanque ground (kind of French bowling) with adult and children balls, and our Molky game
  • Basketball backboard, football goals, volleyball net and all the balls
  • Real 15-meter zip line
  • Giant 5m trampoline
  • Ninja Warrior course
  • Slackline
  • Big toboggan, swings and other games

Inside:

  • Pool table (billiards)
  • Table football
  • Darts
  • Piano
  • Karaoke
  • Vintage video games
  • A library full of books

Surrounding Area:

Cerza Zoo is one of the most beautiful places to see over 1500 animals and is only a 5 min drive away!Other ideas and regional events here: authenticnormandy.fr

Baby sitting and fun activities in French or in English are available upon request.
